Learning outcomes enumerate architecture, differential drive, odometry, PID, EKF, SLAM/AMCL/Nav2, planning and YOLOv8; no additional technical claim.
Content index from traditional versus AI to motion model and demonstration overview.

Traditional versus AI table: predefined mathematical/rule control versus sensor inference/adaptation; AI combines perception, localization, planning and navigation; integrates YOLOv8n WITH classical algorithms, not wholesale replacement.

AMR perceives, decides and navigates without continuous intervention. Perception sensors; localization current position; planning safe efficient path; navigation executes avoiding obstacles; decisions adapt changes. Robot photograph shows components unlabeled here.

Two independently driven wheels and passive stabilizing caster; equal speeds straight, unequal curved. Opposite-direction in-place shorthand requires equal magnitudes under equal-radius model. Source sketches distinguish driven wheel and caster.

v=r(omega_R+omega_L)/2; omega=r(omega_R-omega_L)/L. Radius r and full wheel separation L. Diagram forward v arrow, yaw omega and left/right rates. Applications odometry, wheel control, tracking and navigation; no given numerical values.

Jetson Orin Nano high-level, Arduino Mega2560 real-time motor control, RPLidar mapping, RealSense D435i RGB/depth/IMU. Stack ROS2 Humble, SLAM Toolbox, AMCL, Nav2, robot_localization EKF, YOLOv8n. boundedGaps.angle: Structured/predictable classical-control context versus dynamic/partially unknown sensor-driven adaptation, without claiming classical control is categorically incapable of such environments.
boundedGaps.reason: Q001 tests hybrid integration only. The table’s separate environment/adaptation contrast is not discriminated by any current L59 item.
boundedGaps.suggestedRepair: Extend the existing hybrid-comparison item or add one bounded same-domain contrast; do not restate the current integration answer.

boundedGaps.angle: The source architecture branches Sensor Fusion (EKF) toward both SLAM and AMCL before navigation.
boundedGaps.reason: Current figure items trace the motor column and YOLO-to-costmap link; Q027 concerns input evidence on a different diagram. None checks this two-branch relationship.
boundedGaps.suggestedRepair: Extend a diagram question to identify the two drawn recipients, explicitly as the conceptual source schematic rather than an exact ROS subscription graph.

boundedGaps.angle: Desired wheel velocity → PID → PWM output → DC motor → wheel-encoder feedback, including feedback for continuing correction.
boundedGaps.reason: Roles, arithmetic and performance limits are covered, but no item tests the explicit PWM/plant/feedback chain. The higher-level motor-driver chain does not identify this signal distinction.
boundedGaps.suggestedRepair: Extend the existing motor-chain or PID-role item using this page; do not invent a return arrow absent from the drawing, but use its accompanying feedback statement.
